version.description: Raised by the server on every change; clients send the version they last saw so conflicts can be spotted.

deletedAt.description: Set when the record is deleted; deleted records are kept so other devices learn of the deletion.

timeZone.description: The venue's time zone, for showing the kickoff in local time.

format.description: A copy of the format, so editing the template later doesn't change this match.

templateId.description: The template the format was copied from.

ageGroup.description: Free text, as leagues write it: U12, U19, Adult, O35.

role.description: The user's role in this match.

outlook.description: What to expect: competitive, one-sided, team strengths and so on.

assignor.description: Who assigned the match (SET-15): a name, typed in or set by an integration or import.

pitchMarking.description: The pitch's corners as marked on the watch for this match (TRK-13).

description: One referee's own copy of a match.
